jobs.occupation: Senior IT Windows Server Architect
jobs.description:
Your impact begins here

As Senior IT Windows Server Architect, you will set the vision for the Windows Server operating system platform across Novo Nordisk, and turn it into a roadmap. You will be the architectural authority for two segregated environments: the General Network for enterprise IT services and the Production Network for business-critical production systems. Your decisions will shape how the platform is designed, secured, automated and run for years to come, keeping the systems our business depends on stable every day.

What you’ll bring

You are an established architect who has already set direction for Windows Server platforms in large enterprise companies. You will bring:

· A proven track record in architecture roles, such as Windows Server Architect or Infrastruc-ture Architect, in large, complex enterprise organisations.

· A clear, well-reasoned vision for building a best-in-class Windows Server operating system platform, and the ability to turn that vision into roadmaps, standards and decisions.

· Deep expertise in Windows Server architecture and engineering at scale, including Active Di-rectory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, PKI/certificate services and Windows authentication.

· Expert knowledge of Windows Server security and hardening, privileged access and adminis-trative security models, risk management and lifecycle management.

· Experience architecting high availability, clustering, backup, disaster recovery and resilience for business-critical production environments.

· Experience designing for strict network segregation, including segmentation, firewalls, load balancing and secure communication between network zones.

· A strong grasp of virtualisation (preferably VMware and/or Hyper-V), monitoring and enter-prise management platforms, PowerShell automation and patching architecture.

· The ability to translate business, security and operational requirements into practical archi-tecture, document it clearly and win support for it across teams.

Useful, but not essential:

· Experience with Azure, Azure Arc, hybrid infrastructure, Infrastructure as Code, configuration management and modern automation platforms (highly desirable).

· Experience from regulated, manufacturing, pharmaceutical, financial, healthcare or other highly controlled environments.

What you’ll do

Together with the product owner, you will decide where the platform goes next. This is a strate-gic architecture role, not day-to-day server administration. You will:

· Own the enterprise Windows Server architecture, vision, roadmap and standards across the General and Production environments.

· Define and govern secure, standardised platforms, covering configuration, networking, stor-age, virtualisation, monitoring, backup and recovery.

· Set the security architecture and hardening standards for privileged access, authentication, service accounts, certificates, vulnerability management and compliance.

· Design architectures for segregated networks with secure integrations, controlled access, and high availability and disaster recovery standards that meet business recovery objectives.

· Lead modernisation, including upgrades, migrations, automation, Infrastructure as Code and reducing technical debt.

· Act as the senior technical authority, leading architectural governance and design reviews, and guiding infrastructure, security and application teams.

Who you’ll work with

You will join the Server Platform sub-department within Infrastructure Platforms, part of Enter-prise IT & Quality. The team operates and manages all enterprise servers at Novo Nordisk, cov-ering Windows and Linux in both public and private cloud. Its goal is to streamline server opera-tions across platforms and domains, so they run fast, reliably and in line with compliance re-quirements.

You will work with colleagues in the Philippines, India, Poland, the Czech Republic, Denmark and the United States. Alongside the product owner, you will partner with infrastructure engineer-ing, operations, cybersecurity, network, application, cloud and enterprise architecture teams. Your job is to bring them together around clear architectural decisions and move them forward.

Your hiring manager will be [insert hiring manager name and title].

What you can expect here

You will own the architecture of a platform the whole company relies on. You will be trusted to set direction, challenge convention and make your voice heard, then commit with the team once a decision is made. Working across two very different environments and a global team, you will keep building your skills as the platform moves towards hybrid cloud and automation.

[Insert locally relevant benefits and employment conditions.]

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 742,600.00 to 1,091,600.00 DKK, corre-sponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incen-tives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here: [insert link].

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you have the experience and the vision to build a best-in-class Win-dows Server platform, apply for the Senior IT Windows Server Architect role by 1 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: Deputy Lead Immersion Engineer
jobs.description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challenge and the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals, and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The immersion engineering team is looking for a Deputy Lead Immersion Engineer to strengthen the team. Immersion engineering is taking care of all calculations regarding tunnel elements float up (weight analysis, determine ballast concrete and water, longitudinal section forces, floating stability), transfers in basins and harbour (winch operations with or without vessel assistance), mooring of the tunnel elements, transport to offshore location, immersion (including but not limited to dynamic analyses) and the stability of the elements after immersion.

As the Deputy Lead Immersion Engineer, you will coordinate and participate in the team responsible for floating up and/or hoisting the concrete tunnel elements, equipping them in the port and then transporting and installing them at sea. In a first phase you will participate in the preparation of this crucial operation, by making ballast plans e.g.. In a second phase, you will be part of the operational team that does the immersion work, by going offshore and assist the Immersion Master by giving technical advice. This is what you are prepared to do in Denmark (full time or in 4-2 rotation).

Main tasks and responsibilities:

• As Deputy Lead Immersion Engineer, you will focus on coordination of the tasks for the team and manage the stakeholders

• During the preparatory phase, you are responsible for the ballast plans and float up calculations.

• You take part in the interface management with other departments within FLC regarding specific parts of the T&I scope

• You will coordinate part of the design scope between Work Preparations and the design team based in the Netherlands and Belgium

• You are involved in the management/operation of Tunnel Control Systems

• You ensure the conclusions and results from the design documents are correctly taken over in the work method statements, drawings and operation manuals for the Immersion Pontoon specific operations related to the overall transport and immersion scope

• You liaise with the Marine Warranty Surveyor and contribute to the work procedures, Go/No Go procedures

• During float up and ballasting you check if operations stay within boundary conditions and act accordingly

• During the execution phase, you advise during the transport and installation of the elements. You will be present in the command unit of the immersion pontoons during offshore operations. You will do checks during execution, monitor the immersion process, and have an advisory role to the one in charge of the operation. You are also prepared and ready to deal with contingencies if any might occur

• After immersion, you will organize and do checks on data to create lessons learned for next operations

Qualifications:

• You are a qualified naval architect/maritime engineer/offshore engineer with minimum of 7 years experience

• You have prior experience with immersion of large structures or offshore lifting operations

• You have a good understanding of stability calculations, mooring calculations and hydrodynamics

• You are a hands-on problem solver and a decision maker

• You are a team player with strong communication skills

• You find it a challenge to work in a international, multi-cultural work-environment in which communication and team spirit is key to success

• You are fluent in English.

Conditions: 

FLC considers transparent management structures, short decision-making channels, and a team-oriented environment to be extremely important. The FLC staff is expected to set themselves targets, achieve them independently, and take responsibility for their actions – irrespective of their position in the company.

Full time employment with health insurance and lunch arrangement available upon request.

Workplace:

Based in Rødbyhavn.

Application:

We look forward to receiving your application (in English) as soon as possible and. Applications received will be processed on an ongoing basis, and we will complete the recruitment once we have found the right profile.

jobs.occupation: VP Sales, Europe
jobs.description:
VP Sales Europe

Based out of Teton’s headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark.

About Teton

Teton is building the foundational data layer for the point of care, using real-time, multimodal AI to generate a digital twin of the patient and care environment. Our product alleviates administrative inefficiencies and observational tasks that overburden healthcare professionals, enabling them to provide better patient care.

Through a combination of in-room hardware, AI, and desktop and mobile applications, Teton helps create a seamless healthcare experience for both patients and providers. Our solution provides unprecedented access to real-time data insights, creating a digital twin of resident states and care delivery that empowers healthcare providers with actionable intelligence for optimal decision-making.

With strong demand and clear product-market fit, Teton is focused on scaling its presence across Europe. We operate through a Country Director model across three established territories - the Nordics (Copenhagen), UK&I (London), and the DACH region (Zurich) - selling into both public hospital systems and care home operators. This is a rare opportunity to lead an established multi-country commercial organisation, bring consistency and governance across territories, and open Teton’s next European markets.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Lead, coach, and develop Teton’s European sales organisation in the Nordics, UK&I, and DACH, holding each territory accountable to its new business targets.

• 
Own and optimise Teton’s European commercial operating cadence across pipeline generation, tender and bid qualification, deal progression, forecasting, CRM governance, performance management, and team accountability - creating a consistent governance structure across territories while respecting local market differences.

• 
Act as a hands-on deal leader on Europe's largest opportunities, across both public tenders and complex private enterprise deals - joining critical customer meetings, site visits, and executive presentations to bring deals over the line.

• 
Optimise go-to-market in each territory: segmentation, coverage model, territory design, resourcing, and partner strategy across public hospital systems and private and public care home operators.

• 
Evaluate and open new core European markets, such as the Benelux region - building the market-entry case, the operating model, and the initial commercial footprint.

• 
Recruit, onboard, and develop commercial leadership and talent as Europe scales, while raising the effectiveness of the existing teams.

• 
Represent Teton at major European industry conferences, national associations, while helping refine go-to-market strategy, messaging, pricing, and commercial execution across the region.

What We’re Looking For

• 
Significant experience selling and leading teams that sell large and complex contracts won through public sector tenders and RFPs - a genuine command of the public procurement motion is essential for this role.

• 
Equivalent enterprise experience closing large, complex contracts with private organisations, as both motions exist across Teton’s European territories.

• 
A demonstrated track record as a highly successful individual contributor, consistently exceeding significant new business quotas and closing complex, high six-figure ACV opportunities across long sales cycles.

• 
Proven sales leadership experience managing, coaching, and developing sales leaders and net-new business teams carrying significant new business quotas, ideally across multiple European countries or territories.

• 
The ability to operate as a true player-coach: strategic enough to optimise the sales organisation and operating model, but hands-on enough to actively influence and close critical deals.

• 
Deep experience managing long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles involving executive buyers, procurement, legal, and ownership groups.

• 
A rigorous, data-driven approach to pipeline management, forecasting, CRM accuracy, qualification, performance management, and sales governance.

• 
Experience building or scaling sales teams, segmentation models, territories, processes, methodologies, and repeatable go-to-market motions, including entering new markets.

• 
Exposure to healthcare, hospital systems or senior living is a strong bonus, but not a requirement.

• 
12+ years in enterprise sales, with at least 5 of those spent leading sales teams.

• 
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, with a willingness to travel regularly across Europe.

What We Offer

• 
Competitive salary and participation in our warrant program.

• 
Work with state-of-the-art technology in a pioneering field.

• 
A high-impact leadership position with significant influence over Teton’s European go-to-market strategy, territory structure, and commercial execution.

• 
A vibrant, learning-focused work environment

jobs.occupation: Domain Architect
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Domain Architect to join our Business Engagement and Platform Solutions team, where you will take domain ownership of the application and platform architecture and drive alignment across our architecture practices.

About the job

The role combines architectural ownership with close business engagement. You will define and maintain the target architecture for applications and platforms, contribute to solution design together with our solution architects and delivery teams, and act as a trusted architectural advisor to the business areas you support.

Your key responsibilities

• Take domain ownership of Orifarm's application and platform architecture, including current state, target state and the roadmap between them

• Engage closely with business stakeholders to understand their processes, priorities and ambitions, and translate these into application and platform solutions

• Drive the architecture forum by setting the agenda, preparing decisions and ensuring alignment across the solution, data, integration and infrastructure architecture practices

• Support solution architects and delivery teams through design reviews, architectural guidance and joint solution design

• Develop and maintain reference architectures, design patterns and architectural standards for the application and platform domain

• Drive simplification of the application portfolio through consolidation, lifecycle management and modernization of key applications

• Support the evaluation, selection and integration of new applications and platforms, ensuring that they can be operated and maintained sustainably

Who are you?

We are looking for a pragmatic and business-oriented architect who is comfortable moving between technical design and stakeholder dialogue. You communicate clearly, and you create alignment through collaboration and professional credibility.

We imagine your profile includes:

• +5 years of experience within solution, application or platform architecture, or a background as a senior developer, lead engineer with relevant architectural experience

• Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into concrete application and platform solutions

• Good understanding of cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure, as well as ERP ecosystems and modern integration patterns

• Experience facilitating architectural decisions across teams and disciplines, for example through design reviews or architecture forums

• Experience from a regulated industry such as pharmaceuticals, life science or medical devices is an advantage

• Knowledge of architecture frameworks is an advantage, with emphasis on practical application rather than formal certification

• Professional proficiency in English. Danish or German is an advantage

Who are we?

You will be part of Business Engagement & Platform Solutions, a function of approximately 40 colleagues across three business-aligned solution teams as well as architecture and integration practices with direct reference to the VP of Corporate IT. Moreover, you will join an organization where IT plays a central role in enabling the business strategy, driving commercial outcomes.

The role offers clear ownership of an architecture domain, close cooperation with senior business stakeholders, and the opportunity to help shape our architecture practice as our organization scales.

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of bringing better deals of medicine to millions.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager, Product Services
jobs.description:
Protect the backbone of modern society — by leading the service business behind it. Systematic's National Security & Infrastructure (NSI) unit delivers proven software that helps police, emergency services, intelligence services and critical infrastructure operators detect threats early, coordinate their response and stay resilient against hybrid attacks, cyberattacks and natural disasters. Join NSI as it scales, and take ownership of the customer relationships and 24/7 operations that keep this software running for some of Europe's largest energy operators.

The job

As Senior Manager, Services, you will own the day-to-day running and commercial performance of the service contracts behind our mission-critical software product solutions for major infrastructure customers. You will be the customers' trusted point of contact, responsible for keeping their software operations stable around the clock, while also leading a skilled team and taking a significant role in growing our service business.

In short, you can look forward to:

• Building close, trusted relationships with large customers through regular status and steering meetings

• Driving SLA and incident follow-up in close cooperation with our internal operations team

• Leading and developing a team of technical specialists

• Shaping and growing the NSI service business together with sales, product management and product development

• Owning P&L for individual service contracts, including budgets and forecasts

Joining the team

You will join a technically strong, tight-knit team based in Aarhus, anchored by an experienced architect who acts as technical lead and works directly with customers. The team also carries second- and third-line support and on-call duties, so reliability and trust run deep here.

NSI is still shaping and scaling its business, which means real influence: how we structure our service catalogue, how we work with customers, and how the team grows are all still being defined — and you will take part in defining them. You will work with customers across energy and utilities, with further growth expected towards police, emergency services and intelligence services.

Your qualifications

• Experience delivering or supporting software solutions and services, ideally in a customer-facing operations or hosting setup

• Experience managing large, complex customer relationships and contracts

• People management experience is preferred

• A relevant bachelor's or master’s degree, for example in engineering or business administration

• Fluent English, spoken and written

You are also:

• A strong communicator and relationship builder

• Calm and steady under pressure

• Proactive, and thrive in a dynamic, still-evolving environment

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years, as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Aarhus

At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 events a year of both social and professional character. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, game tables and even our own padel court. Our canteen is a standout feature, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. Beyond the office, you will also enjoy benefits like free ARoS +1 access and various shopping discounts.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

Start your development here

We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Jesper Bennike, Senior Director, Operations, NSI.

jobs.occupation: Portfolio & Capacity Manager for Systematic's Group IT Strategy
jobs.description:
Portfolio & Capacity Manager for Systematic's Group IT Strategy

Can you bring clarity and control to a fast-moving portfolio, making capacity visible, commitments realistic, and decisions easier to steer?

The job

Group IT (GRIT) is Systematic's internal IT function. It supports all business units with infrastructure, systems, integrations, and governance. As Portfolio & Capacity Manager, you will keep our IT portfolio governed, visible, and deliverable, and give the organisation a clear picture of whether commitments match available capacity.

This role sits close to the top of the organisation. The portfolio and capacity overview you maintain is used directly by our CIO and senior leadership to decide what Systematic takes on next, and what is delayed. The accuracy of your work has a direct bearing on the quality of those decisions.

Some of your key responsibilities will be to:

• Own the live overview of who is working on what and how much capacity is available, by collecting, validating, and maintaining data in Excel, Power BI, or similar tools

• Assess new project requests together with the Enterprise Architect and the Director, so we understand what committing to new work would mean for the portfolio

• Onboard new project managers into our governance model, help them get started properly, and keep documentation consistent across the portfolio

• Support the handover of projects from planning into delivery and operation, so nothing crosses over undocumented

• Prepare decision-ready material for the steering committee, run the meeting cadence, and follow up on decisions and actions

Joining the team

The portfolio machinery you will operate is still being created, and you will help shape it. Our ambition is to mature the portfolio into a transparent and trusted view of what is underway, what will be delivered and when, and the value it creates. This will enable clearer communication with the business, while strengthening follow-through within IT and ensuring that capacity is aligned with demand so commitments can be delivered efficiently and to a high standard.

You will become part of the GRIT Strategy team, a small group where specialists and project managers work closely together to keep our internal strategy on track. Reporting to the Director of Group IT Strategy, you will take over a running portfolio process from an interim consultant and work closely with project managers, the Enterprise Architect, and GRIT leadership.

The team is based in Aarhus. If you are located in Copenhagen, we are open to discussing a hybrid arrangement, but you should expect regular presence in Aarhus (6–8 days per month).

Your qualifications

The most important thing you bring is solid experience from an IT portfolio office - where you have supported IT project delivery, system implementations, IT operations - combined with strong analytical skills and hands-on experience with Excel and Power BI, or similar tools, to build and maintain reliable overviews (experience with Jira is an advantage). Additionally, we expect that you have:

• A good understanding of project management and agile ways of working

• Strong communication skills and the ability to present clearly to senior stakeholders

• Comfort exploring AI tools, like Claude, to work smarter and improve how we report and prioritise

• Fluent English; Danish is an advantage

Personally, you enjoy diligent, hands-on work and take pride in keeping information complete, consistent, and current. You are comfortable following up with stakeholders when inputs are missing or unclear, and you thrive as a senior specialist who takes ownership of your domain and leads through sound judgement, structure, and attention to detail.

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects.

Welcome to Systematic Aarhus

At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 events a year of both social and professional character. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, game tables, and even our own padel court. Our canteen is a standout feature, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. Beyond the office, you will also enjoy benefits like free ARoS +1 access and various shopping discounts.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1,100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

Start your development here

We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Nanna Holmann Opstrup, Director of Group IT Strategy.

jobs.occupation: Lead Developer
jobs.description:
Are you ready to take technical ownership of a business-critical application landscape and drive the modernization of software platforms in Orifarm - an international pharmaceutical company with high ambitions and a digital transformation agenda?

About the job

As Lead Developer, you will take technical ownership of Orifarm’s business-critical application landscape and help drive the modernization of our software platforms.

You will work in an environment consisting of custom-developed .NET applications, SQL Server databases, integrations, and web-based solutions. The landscape contains a mix of legacy and modern technologies, and an important part of the role will be balancing day-to-day delivery with long-term improvements.

You will provide technical leadership within the development team, drive modernization, helping to shape solution designs, ensuring code quality, and driving continuous improvement across applications and development practices while remaining hands-on with coding yourself.

Responsibilities

• Provide technical leadership and guidance to the development team, contribute to architectural discussions, review code, and promote development best practices

• Ensure high standards for maintainability, performance, security, and quality, and support developers in solving complex technical challenges

• Design, develop, and maintain business-critical applications, participating actively in hands-on development

• Analyze existing applications and identify opportunities for improvement and modernization, contributing to the evolution of legacy systems while supporting the introduction of new technologies

• Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into scalable solutions

• Work closely with development team to ensure alignment between architecture and implementation

• Participate in planning, estimation, and prioritization activities, and support deployments, releases, and operational improvements

Who Are You?

You are an experienced developer who combines deep C# and SQL Server expertise with strong leadership capabilities. You are comfortable investigating a complex stored procedure, reviewing application architecture, mentoring developers, and making pragmatic technical decisions that keep the business moving forward.

You understand modern development practices and web technologies, but you also appreciate the realities of maintaining and evolving business-critical systems that have been developed over many years. You enjoy solving complex technical problems, you lead by example, you take ownership of technical quality and delivery, and you are motivated by improving systems, processes, and ways of working.

Key Qualifications:

• 7+ years of experience as a Senior Developer, Lead Developer, Technical Lead, or similar role, including experience leading development teams or acting as a technical mentor

• Experience working with enterprise applications and complex business systems, and a strong understanding of software architecture and design patterns

• Experience working with both legacy systems and modernization initiatives

• Strong hands-on experience with C# / .NET, ASP.NET, web application development, Microsoft SQL Server, database design and optimization, REST APIs, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Git

• Experience with Azure, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, Entity Framework, Microservices, or Microsoft Entra ID is considered an advantage

• Ability to communicate effectively with developers, architects, and business stakeholders, and to balance pragmatism with engineering excellence

Who Are We?

You will be part of Business Engagement & Platform Solutions, a function of approximately 45 professionals across three business-aligned solution teams as well as architecture and integration practices.

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of bringing better deals of medicine to millions.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

jobs.occupation: Category Lead
jobs.description:
Shape the future of strategic sourcing at scale. Lead critical supplier relationships and category strategies that directly impact our ability to deliver life-saving medicines to millions of patients worldwide.

Your new role

As Category Lead in Drug Product Outsourcing, you'll be at the forefront of strategic sourcing and procurement, driving commercial excellence across complex supplier landscapes. This is a role where your decisions have real business impact – from negotiating multi-million agreements to building long-term partnerships that secure our supply chain.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Leading end-to-end category management including strategy development, market analysis, supplier negotiations, and contract finalization

• Building and maintaining strategic supplier relationships while managing risk assessment and opportunity identification across your category

• Driving commercial edge and customer-oriented behavior, utilizing market intelligence and tools to deliver significant cost savings and supply chain optimization

• Overseeing category cluster activities, coaching and mentoring team members to build capabilities and remove roadblocks

• Developing market insights and preparing strategic analysis on suppliers, spend patterns, and category trends to inform decision-making at all organizational levels

• Negotiating prices and contracts with suppliers within agreed targets, ensuring compliance with Novo Nordisk's corporate guidelines and global signing rules

• Leading cross-functional projects independently, mobilizing specialized competences across the organization to achieve optimal outcomes

Your new department

In CMC & Product Supply, we cover the full value chain from drug and device development to marketed Novo Nordisk products. We are more than 30,000 colleagues across the globe with the shared responsibility of scaling molecules, processes, devices, and products, dedicated to supplying life-saving medicines to the patients who need them most.

Within Drug Product Outsourcing, you'll join a team dedicated to securing supply availability across key sourcing categories. We act as the critical link between internal stakeholders and external suppliers, ensuring the right balance between organizational needs and optimal supply solutions. Your role will be pivotal in driving cross-functional projects that directly impact our ability to serve patients globally.

Your skills & qualifications

To succeed in this strategic role, you'll need to strike the right balance between commercial acumen and relationship building. We're looking for someone who brings:

• Minimum 10 years of experience in strategic sourcing with a proven track record, preferably within a large international company; recognized as a subject matter expert within sourcing competences

• Master's degree or MBA in management, business, or engineering (preferred)

• Exceptional ability to navigate complex and dynamic organizations, building relationships and trust while securing commitment from internal and external stakeholders

• Strong commercial mindset with the confidence to be a constructive sparring partner on key sourcing issues and challenge approaches based on solid analysis

• Proven capability to train and coach colleagues with less experience, actively supporting their development and knowledge sharing

• Ability to impact decision-making at all levels of the organization through clear recommendations based on solid analyses

• Project management expertise including the ability to plan, drive problem-solving, and prepare compelling business cases

• Personal drive and strong execution skills combined with analytical thinking and business understanding

• Excellent communication skills in both oral and written English, including professional presentation capabilities (content and presentation)

• Ability to work independently with minimal guidance while knowing when to seek advice on complex issues, and collaborative skills to work effectively across project teams

• Demonstrated ability to frequently set directions and deliver results that have significant savings and business impact

Working at Novo Nordisk

Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. Here, you'll find a culture that values your expertise and perspective, offers opportunities to grow as we transform, and empowers you to drive innovation in everything you do. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.

What we offer

There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 742,600 DKK to 1,091,600 DKK (DK), corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Deadline

Application deadline: 25 October 2026

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Novo Nordisk is not your typical healthcare company. In a modern world of quick fixes, we focus on solutions to defeat serious chronic diseases and promote long-term health. Our unordinary mindset is at the heart of everything we do. We seek out new ideas and put people first as we push the boundaries of science, make healthcare more accessible, and treat, prevent, and even cure diseases that affect millions of lives. Because it takes an unordinary approach to drive real, lasting change in health.

jobs.occupation: Senior Sourcing Specialist
jobs.description:
Job titleSenior Sourcing SpecialistJob description:
At BeGreen, we develop and operate renewable energy projects built to last across generations. 

We are looking for a commercially driven Senior Sourcing Specialist with a strong background in renewables to lead sourcing activities and commercial contracting across solar, hybrid, and energy storage projects based in Denmark, with exposure to international suppliers and projects. 

This position is ideal for someone who understands the unique sourcing and commercial challenges of renewable energy, whether in solar, BESS, or hybrid technologies—and who knows that the right supplier relationships and contracts are what make or break a project. Broader experience in energy infrastructure, construction, or adjacent industries is equally welcome, and will add valuable perspective to our team. 

About the role 

You will take ownership of sourcing strategies, supplier engagement, and contract execution across the full renewable energy project lifecycle. Working closely with Project Management, Engineering, Construction, Sustainability, Cyber Security, HSE, and Legal, you will ensure that commercial decisions drive project performance and long-term value. 

Your hands-on knowledge of the renewables market—its key suppliers, technology trends, cost drivers, and contractual complexities—will be a distinct advantage in this role. Whether you're navigating a large EPC tender for a solar park, structuring a BESS supply agreement, or evaluating a new contractor in an emerging market, your sector insight will be central to how you work. 

Beyond large and complex tenders, you will also support pragmatic sourcing for lower-value purchases, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and speed without compromising quality or governance. 

Key responsibilities 

• Lead end-to-end competitive tenders for major renewable energy packages, including planning, evaluation, negotiation, and contract award 
• Develop and execute sourcing strategies specifically tailored to solar parks, hybrid plants, and battery energy storage systems 
• Leverage renewables market knowledge to drive supplier assessments, benchmark pricing, and identify strategic sourcing opportunities 
• Lead commercial negotiations with energy suppliers and contractors, with a strong focus on risk management and contract robustness 
• Manage both complex, high-value sourcing processes and agile lower-value purchasing activities (RFQs, call-offs, POs) 
• Prepare decision-making materials, including total cost of ownership analyses with a clear understanding of energy project cost structures 
• Support early contract management, including supplier onboarding, performance tracking, and risk assessments 
• Contribute market intelligence on renewable energy supply chains to strengthen category strategies and long-term supplier partnerships 
What you bring 

We are looking for someone with a solid commercial background, and we particularly value: 

• Direct sourcing or commercial experience in solar, BESS, hybrid energy, wind or other renewable technologies 
• Familiarity with key renewable energy suppliers, EPC contractors, and technology providers 
• Understanding of the commercial and technical dynamics specific to utility-scale renewable projects 
 Broader energy & infrastructure experience (also highly valued): 

• Experience in conventional energy, oil & gas, transmission, or large-scale infrastructure procurement 
• Background in complex project environments with multi-stakeholder commercial interfaces 
• Exposure to long-term contracts, framework agreements, and supplier performance management 
In addition, you bring: 

• Confidence in leading negotiations and managing commercial interfaces
• A structured, proactive, and ownership-driven approach to work
• Strong stakeholder management and clear communication skills
• Knowledge of EU procurement regulations (Utilities Directive) or the motivation to build it
• Fluency in English; proficiency in Danish or Swedish is a plus
• Relocation packages are not available for this role and a valid Danish work- and residence permit is a precondition
The team you will join 

You will join BeGreen's Procurement team, a group of specialists working across category management, sourcing, and contract management. We collaborate closely, share knowledge openly, and prioritize integrity in both processes and relationships.  

 

What we offer 

• A key role in shaping sourcing practices at a fast-growing renewable energy company 
• Influence across the full project lifecycle—from early development through construction to operations 
• A collaborative, international work environment with passionate and ambitious colleagues 
• A strong focus on professional development and continuous learning 
• Office based in Carlsberg Byen, Copenhagen.  

About BeGreen 

BeGreen develops, builds, and operates onshore energy facilities – primarily solar, wind, and battery solutions. We are around 60 colleagues from diverse backgrounds. We design our projects to work in practice – technically, commercially, and in interaction with local communities. 

BeGreen is headquartered in Denmark and is part of Equinor, an international energy company. This provides a strong foundation and access to experience and competencies across markets. 

Our values: collaboration, integrity and ambition are applied to our projects, decisions, and the way we work together internally and externally.

jobs.occupation: Are you at your best when others are winding down? Join NORMAL's evening team in Hedensted

jobs.occupation: Ready to bring your A-game every day? Join NORMAL's warehouse team in Hedensted
jobs.description:
Do you like a workday where things move fast, expectations are clear, and everyone contributes to reaching the day's goals?

For NORMAL's warehouse in Hedensted, we are looking for reliable and motivated warehouse employees for the day shift. You don't need to be the loudest person on the team – but we do need you to show up, take responsibility and deliver a stable effort every day.

At NORMAL, you will become part of a busy warehouse where teamwork, efficiency and quality go hand in hand. You will know what is expected of you, receive feedback along the way and work towards clear daily performance targets.

What will your workday look like?

Your main tasks will include:

• Picking and packing goods using a handheld scanner

• Handling and moving goods throughout the warehouse

• Operating a runner – previous experience is a strong advantage

• Keeping a steady and efficient work pace

• Working together with your colleagues to reach the team's daily goals

This is an active job, so you should enjoy being on the move throughout your shift.

Who are we looking for?

For us, the right attitude is just as important as speed.

We are looking for someone who:

• Is reliable and stable – your team can count on you

• Is flexible and ready to contribute where needed

• Takes responsibility for their own tasks and performance

• Understands that clear targets are part of the job

• Can maintain a consistent performance throughout the day

• Is open to feedback and uses it to improve

• Works efficiently while maintaining quality

• Contributes positively to the team

Previous warehouse experience, particularly within picking and packing, is preferred. Experience operating a runner or similar warehouse equipment is a significant advantage.

Clear expectations – from day one

At NORMAL, performance matters.

The warehouse works with clear picking targets and performance expectations, and productivity is followed throughout the working day.

That means you should be comfortable knowing what is expected of you and motivated by reaching your targets consistently.

You don't have to be perfect on your first day. But we expect you to be engaged, listen to feedback, take responsibility for your development and work towards becoming a strong and stable member of the team.

Your working hours – Day Shift

Monday – Thursday: 07:00 – 15:00

Friday: 07:00 – 14:30

Your shift includes a 20-minute paid break and a 30-minute unpaid break.

What do we offer?

• DKK 173.60 per hour

• Holiday pay, pension and optional-choice account (Fritvalg)

• Employment according to applicable collective agreements

• An active workday where the time moves quickly

• Clear expectations and feedback on your performance

• Good colleagues and a strong team environment

• Experience from a large and growing company

• Possibility of long-term employment for candidates who perform well and are a good match

Does this sound like you?

You show up. You take responsibility. You keep your pace. You listen to feedback. And you want to be part of a team where everyone is expected to contribute.

Then we would like to hear from you.

Apply today – interviews are held on an ongoing basis.

Working through JKS

As a temporary employee through JKS, you get proper and transparent employment conditions. You are employed according to applicable collective agreements, ensuring fair working conditions and timely salary payments.

Temporary employment can also be a great way to get your foot in the door. Many companies recruit permanent employees from their temporary workforce – so for the right candidate, this could be the beginning of something longer-term.
